headline: Q2FY27 Result Update

highlights: Positives: • Blue Dart Express (BDE)’s revenue grew by ~15% yoy to Rs 1774 cr (in line). • EBITDA margin came in at 16.2% (40 bps) against our estimate of 16%. • EBITDA grew by ~14% yoy to Rs 287 (4% above our estimate). • APAT stood at Rs 103.9 cr (10% above our estimate). • BDE strengthened customer engagement through targeted outreach. • BDE recently entered into strategic partnerships to explore new avenues.
Negatives: • Low margin ground express now constitutes more than 30% of the aggregate revenue. ` ` ` The content of this document has been derived from Kotak Securities PCG research report.
